## Objective

Prepare canonical D3 scalar pairs, fixed physical stencils and transform-independent source quality/support. Stratify source centers in world cells, reject degenerate source patches, pre-normalize once in Double, and record all chosen scales/budgets.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 5.2, FA-04. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `Preparation`
- `PatchPopulation`
- `preparation fixtures`

## Acceptance criteria

1. 27-point offsets, 10-30k target candidates and reduced-support behavior are deterministic and physically defined.
2. Low signal, signed intensities, slabs and tiny volumes are handled without a positive-intensity brain-mask assumption.
3. No hidden time/channel selection, source-owner copy hierarchy or optimizer-time moving normalization.

## Blocking prerequisites

- B04 (`bd-01M2B1146HMQV54YH5WQTT0N60`): FA-B04: Add the experimental Flashalign cross-project and typed API skeleton
- L04 (`bd-01M2B114VKG27ANATK8MG2M7DJ`): FA-L04: Compile allocation-bounded sparse value/gradient sampling
- L05 (`bd-01M2B114ZMGTZNVFPX0ENKT0Z6`): FA-L05: Add support-aware physical pyramid and PSF preparation

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
